blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Oriental Mindoro served the dismissal order issued by the Office of the Ombudsman against Baco, Oriental Mindoro Mayor Allan Roldan at around 5:00 p.m. on Thursday, Oct. 22. With the order served, Vice Mayor Eric Castillo has automatically assumed the position as the new municipal mayor. DILG Oriental Mindoro Provincial Director Erick Gumabol personally served the order at Roldan’s office at the municipal hall. Roldan peacefully accepted the order and stepped down from his post.
